name: Meshpoint optional plugins (unreleased)
description: Select only the optional receivers you need. No automatic setup or enablement.

plugins.description: The RTL-SDR host page -- every RTL-SDR plugin (Radio, DAB+, P2000, Pagers, POCSAG, RTL433, ADS-B, ACARS) hooks its own tab into this page via the 'hook' seam instead of owning a page of its own.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Aircraft VHF datalink (ACARS) decoding via acarsdec + libacars
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Live ADS-B (1090 MHz) air traffic tracking via dump1090 -- aircraft table plus a live map
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Generic RTL-SDR OOK/FSK decoder (rtl_433) -- weather stations, TPMS, remote sensors, and hundreds of other 433/315/868 MHz devices
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: DAB/DAB+ digital radio via welle-cli -- channel scan, live tuning/playback, and per-channel display names
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: FM/AM/SSB broadcast & utility radio listener via rtl_fm + ffmpeg, with RDS on FM via redsea -- Digital and Analogue display skins, a preset stations picker, and a Web Audio VU meter
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: POCSAG512/1200/2400 pager decoding on an explicitly selected receive frequency via rtl_fm + multimon-ng
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Dutch emergency dispatch (P2000, FLEX on 169.65 MHz) decoding via rtl_fm + multimon-ng
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: POCSAG512/1200/2400 pager decoding on an explicitly selected receive frequency via rtl_fm + multimon-ng
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Reticulum/LXMF messaging, peers, NomadNet pages, propagation and opt-in telemetry. Interfaces are off by default.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC
